attacks.label: Prism Wingbeat Weave
attacks.recognitionCue: One wing folds and illuminates before a left-right crystal-feather rhythm ends in a coordinated opening.
attacks.solution: Move away from each lit wing, then settle into the final central lane when both wings open.

attacks.label: Brood Procession
attacks.recognitionCue: The wings cradle the abdomen while paired brood pods descend, illuminate, crack, and hatch in sequence.
attacks.solution: Read the cocoon order and follow the opening carried by the coordinated moth formation.

attacks.label: Lunar Prism Swoop
attacks.recognitionCue: The wings fold, one screen edge glints, and the full moth commits to a graceful curved crossing.
attacks.solution: Read the lit entry edge, remain below the curve, then switch sides before the opposite return pass.

attacks.label: Kaleidoscope Brood
attacks.recognitionCue: The moth cocoons around its core, unfolds completely, and illuminates ordered wing sections that command matching brood nodes.
attacks.solution: Follow the corridor indicated by each lit wing section; the final core pulse returns the escape route to center.

attacks.label: Chainclaw Harpoon
attacks.recognitionCue: One winch unlocks, the matching pincer opens, and visible chain slack points toward a fixed target before launch.
attacks.solution: Read the armed side, leave the locked claw lane, then cross behind the taut chain while the winch retracts and reseats.

attacks.label: Crown Reactor Beam
attacks.recognitionCue: The crown rises, shell shutters open, and cyan energy spokes converge into the exact beam route before it fires.
attacks.solution: Cross behind the phase-one sweep. In Critical Cross-Link, enter the warned empty lane between the two tapered relays and ride that lane through the sweep.

attacks.label: Bastion Crabwalk Barrage
attacks.recognitionCue: The legs plant in alternating tripods and the shell-side bastion ports light in the same order as the coming lateral march.
attacks.solution: Read the first planted side, trail the deliberate crabwalk, and step through the alternating bolt gaps rather than racing the hull.

attacks.label: Crown Cross-Link
attacks.recognitionCue: Both crown relays flare, both winches reverse, and the two visible chains draw a four-beat crossing lattice before each reseat.
attacks.solution: Enter behind the first crossing chain, reverse with the second locked diagonal, then use the final uncrossing beat to return center.

attacks.label: Rapid Machine-Gun Bursts
attacks.recognitionCue: One rotary spools into a rapid burst, the opposite gun answers a moment later, then both finish together.
attacks.solution: Read the first muzzle, make one controlled dodge through the reply, then hold the remaining center opening.

attacks.label: Moving Machine-Gun Channel
attacks.recognitionCue: Both mounted rotaries spool together, herd the exterior lanes inward, then Helios braces high and begins a smooth horizontal sweep.
attacks.solution: Move through the center opening as the first tracers close the exterior lanes, then follow the opening between the two moving streams until both guns settle.

attacks.label: Reactor Maze
attacks.recognitionCue: The body braces and the reactor opens before drawing a downward fan a few rounds at a time; a separate beat visibly deploys and arms a bounded mine formation.
attacks.solution: Read the fan order, cross its widening lanes between beats, then route around armed mines before their proximity explosions become active.

attacks.label: Clawcarrier Crush
attacks.recognitionCue: The carrier rises, opens both claws, follows the player briefly, locks the route, then commits to one uninterrupted crushing dive.
attacks.solution: Bait the short tracking stage, leave the locked area before the dive, and stay outside the visibly closed claw tips until they release.

attacks.label: Gravity Well Genesis
attacks.recognitionCue: The core compresses two gravity seeds before casting them into the upper arena.
attacks.solution: Read each forming well, cross its quiet side, and never wait beneath an implosion.

attacks.label: Event Horizon Gaze
attacks.recognitionCue: The central lens tracks, locks, and brightens before the damaging horizon appears.
attacks.solution: Move during tracking, respect the lock, then ride the warned fixed, sweeping, or split lane.

attacks.label: Tidal Claw Pincer
attacks.recognitionCue: Both lower claws brace wide, then curl inward around one readable center route.
attacks.solution: Commit to the warned middle route and follow the staggered claw that closes second.

attacks.label: Orbital Pylon Barrage
attacks.recognitionCue: The four pylons ignite one after another in their exact firing order.
attacks.solution: Cross a pylon lane only after its visible recoil, then answer the next lit socket.

attacks.label: Singularity Pulse
attacks.recognitionCue: The core expands into repeated gravity rings whose two opposing dark notches shift between bursts.
attacks.solution: Enter a warned notch, then zigzag with each offset opening instead of holding one stationary lane.

attacks.label: Gravity Collapse
attacks.recognitionCue: Every pylon folds inward while three warned wells align around the compressed core.
attacks.solution: Read the implosion order, rotate through each released quadrant, then punish the exhausted core.

attacks.label: Wing Shear Crossfire
attacks.recognitionCue: The wing emitters flare in a visible port-starboard rhythm.
attacks.solution: Cross behind each committed wing lane, then reverse with the alternating emitter.

attacks.label: Broken Clockwise Opening
attacks.recognitionCue: The wings open in sequence while the core turns one broken downward spiral.
attacks.solution: Read the missing wedge and weave with it as each sequential salvo rotates the opening.

attacks.label: Blackout Laser
attacks.recognitionCue: The arena blacks out while detached red eyes mark one committed laser lane.
attacks.solution: Read the eye and lock line, wait for commitment, then leave the laser lane before it fires.

attacks.label: Blackout Hunt
attacks.recognitionCue: Umbra dissolves into darkness and red eyes reveal each controlled corner charge.
attacks.solution: Wait for each eye pair to lock, leave that lane, and let Umbra fully exit before reading the next charge.
